issues.title: CLI Argument Parsing - Command-line argument parser setup
issues.description:
## Feature Description
Set up command-line argument parser for user inputs using argparse.

## Requirements
- Use argparse to define CLI commands and options
- Support --help flag for usage instructions
- Validate required arguments
- Provide clear error messages for invalid inputs

## Test Steps
1. Run with --help flag → displays usage information
2. Run with missing required args → shows error message
3. Run with valid args → processes successfully

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] argparse parser is initialized with all required commands
- [ ] --help flag displays comprehensive usage information
- [ ] Required arguments are validated before execution
- [ ] Invalid inputs show clear, actionable error messages

issues.title: Core Command Implementation - Main functionality
issues.description:
## Feature Description
Implement main functionality of the tool to scan MCP servers and AI agent skills.

## Requirements
- Process input data according to tool purpose
- Handle errors gracefully with user-friendly messages
- Output results in clear, readable format
- Support common CLI patterns (stdin/stdout)

## Test Steps
1. Execute core command with valid input → produces expected output
2. Execute with invalid input → shows helpful error message
3. Verify output format is readable and correct

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Core scanning logic is implemented
- [ ] Errors are caught and handled gracefully
- [ ] Output format is clear and readable
- [ ] stdin/stdout patterns are supported

issues.title: File I/O Operations - Reading and writing files
issues.description:
## Feature Description
Handle reading from and writing to files for input/output operations.

## Requirements
- Support reading from files or stdin
- Support writing to files or stdout
- Handle file not found errors
- Validate file formats where applicable

## Test Steps
1. Read from input file → processes correctly
2. Write to output file → creates file with correct content
3. Handle missing input file → shows clear error

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] File reading works from both files and stdin
- [ ] File writing works to both files and stdout
- [ ] Missing files are handled with clear error messages
- [ ] File formats are validated appropriately

issues.title: Logging and Debugging - Verbose logging support
issues.description:
## Feature Description
Add logging support for troubleshooting using Python logging module.

## Requirements
- Use Python logging module
- Support --verbose flag for detailed output
- Log important operations and errors
- Default to quiet operation

## Test Steps
1. Run normally → minimal output
2. Run with --verbose → shows detailed logs
3. Errors are logged with context

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Python logging module is configured
- [ ] --verbose flag controls output verbosity
- [ ] Important operations are logged
- [ ] Default mode is quiet with minimal output

issues.title: Testing Suite - Comprehensive pytest coverage
issues.description:
## Feature Description
Comprehensive pytest test coverage for the CLI tool.

## Requirements
- Unit tests for core functions
- Integration tests for CLI commands
- Test edge cases and error conditions
- Achieve >80% code coverage

## Test Steps
1. Run pytest → all tests pass
2. Tests cover main functionality
3. Tests verify error handling

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests for core functions are written
- [ ] Integration tests for CLI commands exist
- [ ] Edge cases and errors are tested
- [ ] Code coverage exceeds 80%
